output.reason: On its own, the cited line [ev-1a27180320cd] only says that metallb-bgp support was removed. The same upgrade-notes section makes it concrete. [ev-42d13e5eb7d7] names the removed Helm options `bgp.enabled`, `bgp.announce.podCIDR` and `bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP`, and [ev-32984cccce52] names the removed agent flags `bgp-config-path`, `bgp-announce-lb-ip` and `bgp-announce-pod-cidr`. Together these give a declarative exposure condition (applicability). Both items say users must now use the Cilium BGP control plane (`bgpControlPlane`) for BGP announcements, so an environment that does nothing loses metallb-based BGP advertisement and has to migrate (consequence). The section does not say whether the removed options are rejected or silently ignored.
